approach: Static recompilation of the PS2 MIPS code to C++, with a native GS/VU1/VIF/IOP/SPU2 layer and an OpenGL 3.3 renderer
notes: Runs at full speed natively. GPU renderer up to 4x internal resolution, HD texture packs, frame generation (30 to ~60 FPS), launcher with one-click updates, controller and keyboard/mouse prompts, online two-player co-op, multiple save slots, and a mod SDK. Bring your own disc; the installer builds the game on your PC.
